mapper.sql: ID, EVENT_ID, REQUEST_ID, EVENT_TYPE, PROCESSING_STATUS, CREATED_AT, PROCESSED_AT, ERROR_MESSAGE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION_LOG (EVENT_ID, REQUEST_ID, EVENT_TYPE, PROCESSING_STATUS, CREATED_AT, PROCESSED_AT) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{requestId}, #{eventType}, 'PROCESSED', #{createdAt}, #{processedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTIFICATION_LOG SET PROCESSING_STATUS = 'PROCESSED', PROCESSED_AT = #{processedAt}, ERROR_MESSAGE = NULL WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND PROCESSING_STATUS = 'FAILED'

MERGE INTO NOTIFICATION_LOG t USING (SELECT #{eventId} AS EVENT_ID FROM DUAL) s ON (t.EVENT_ID = s.EVENT_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage} WHERE t.PROCESSING_STATUS = 'FAILED' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (EVENT_ID, REQUEST_ID, EVENT_TYPE, PROCESSING_STATUS, CREATED_AT, ERROR_MESSAGE) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{requestId}, #{eventType}, 'FAILED', #{createdAt}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM NOTIFICATION_LOG WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT, ID
